PRECISION ENGINEERING SERVICES

Precision Field Surveys & CAD Designs

From on-site roof geometry and electrical panel audits to permit-ready plan sets. Standardized field data and technical drawings for Solar EPCs and installers.

CORE CAPABILITIES

Two Dedicated Engineering Disciplines

Choose standalone field surveys, custom CAD drafting, or our integrated survey-to-permit turnkey pipeline.

SERVICE 01
FIELD VERIFICATION

Precision Solar Site Surveys

Standardized on-site data collection to eliminate drafting discrepancies. Roof pitch mapping, attic structural analysis, MSP dead-front audits, and NFPA 855 battery clearances.

  • Digital pitch gauge & obstruction offset mapping
  • Main electrical panel (MSP) interior dead-front audit
  • Attic rafter/truss structural dimensions & spans
  • 50+ HD categorized photo directory & cloud package

SERVICE 02
ENGINEERING & PERMITTING

Permit-Ready CAD Designs

Complete architectural and electrical drawing packages tailored to your AHJ requirements. Single-line diagrams, string sizing, structural load notes, and utility submittals.

  • Full solar PV & ESS permit plan sets (.DWG & .PDF)
  • Single-line (SLD) & three-line electrical diagrams
  • NEC 705.12, NEC 690, & NFPA 855 code compliance
  • PE structural & electrical stamp-ready packages
